title: roll_dice auto-attach is withdrawn by one-request dice
skill_evidence: references/custom-tools.md:128 "(v2.4.6, #5798/#5901) Game Mode attaches the dice tool to **every** game turn whether or not Function Calling is on"
reality: CHANGELOG 2.4.6 #6215 (CHANGELOG-v2.5.0.md:875-876): 'Finish rolled turns in one request' in Chat Settings -> Function Calling (off by default); 'While one-request dice is on, the dice tool is no longer attached to a Game turn by default'. Code: packages/server/src/routes/generate.routes.ts:4392-4399 (gameDiceToolAutoAttached requires !oneRequestDiceTurn; an explicitly enabled tool is still honored). Label: en.json chat.settings.tools.oneRequestDice. architecture.md:191 covers the setting but custom-tools.md states the auto-attach as unconditional.
fix: custom-tools.md roll_dice bullet: after 'every game turn whether or not Function Calling is on' add '- unless **Finish rolled turns in one request** (Chat Settings -> Function Calling, off by default; v2.4.6, #6215) is on: then the dice tool is not auto-attached; the GM writes both outcome branches or a `[[roll: 2d6+3]]` placeholder and the engine fills the number in (a tool you enabled yourself is still sent). See architecture.md -> Real dice.'

title: Ruleset catalog refresh also offers newly added columns
skill_evidence: references/rulesets.md:63 "**Refresh from ruleset -> Review -> Update selected** offers newer *text* only."
reality: CHANGELOG 2.5.0 #6400 (line 684): 'Refresh from ruleset offers newly added columns, including numbers and switches, for existing picked rows while preserving values already on the sheet'. docs/extending/writing-rulesets.md:557-559: existing values compared only in text/longtext/dice/enum columns; 'A column the row does not yet contain can be offered with its typed value, including numbers and switches.' en.json ui.rulesets.sheet.refreshAddedColumn '{{label}} (new to this row)'. UI flow is the notice '{{count}} rows have newer text in the ruleset.' + **Review** -> **Update selected** ('Refresh from ruleset' is the guide heading, not a control).
fix: rulesets.md Catalogs bullet: 'When a newer ruleset version changes a picked row, a line under the list ("N rows have newer text in the ruleset") offers **Review** -> tick rows -> **Update selected**. It compares only text/longtext/dice/enum columns and also offers columns the row does not have yet, numbers and switches included (v2.5.0, #6400); numbers and switches already on the sheet are never overwritten.'

Add a battle-table row 'Items: those with a `use` do what it says in Classic/Tactical (#6905/#6909); in `combat` fights held weapons are attacks.'
